import bpy,numpy as np,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;c=bpy.data.collections['Terminal_Craft']
report={}
for fn in ['HarborCraft_WorkingTimber_albedo','HarborCraft_NavySlate_albedo']:
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(root/'assets/coast'/(fn+'.png')),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='Non-Color';im.reload()
 a=np.empty(len(im.pixels),np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(a);a=a.reshape(im.size[1],im.size[0],4)
 report[fn]={'size':list(im.size),'pixel_5_5':np.round(a[-6,5,:3]*255).tolist(),'pixel_50_50':np.round(a[-51,50,:3]*255).tolist()}
 bpy.data.images.remove(im)
o=c.objects.get('Terminal deck 00 0');uv=o.data.uv_layers.active
q=[p for p in o.data.polygons if p.normal.z>.75]
ids=[i for p in q for i in p.loop_indices]
coords=np.array([uv.data[i].uv[:] for i in ids])
report['deck_uv']={'min':coords.min(0).tolist(),'max':coords.max(0).tolist(),'faces':len(q),'v':[[list(o.data.vertices[o.data.loops[i].vertex_index].co),list(uv.data[i].uv)] for i in ids[:4]]}
print(json.dumps(report))
